tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Promptafire lessons and blog posts. Returns ids for fetch, titles, and web URLs. Lesson ids look like lesson:<module>/<section>, post ids like post:<slug>.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Return the full Markdown of one search result by id. Free lessons and blog posts always; Pro lessons only when the connected Promptafire account has Pro access, otherwise a short locked notice.

tools.name: search_curriculum
tools.description: Full-text search across Promptafire lessons. Returns module, section, whether it is free or Pro, a short snippet when readable, and the web URL.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: The full curriculum: every track and module with its access level and a link to its overview.

tools.name: get_module
tools.description: A module's description, duration, access level, and section list.

tools.name: read_lesson
tools.description: The Markdown body of one lesson section. Free modules always. Pro modules only when the connected Promptafire account has Pro access.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Every published Promptafire blog post with date, author, and a link.

tools.name: read_post
tools.description: The Markdown body of one blog post.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_curriculum, list_posts, read_post · Public sink: search, list_posts, read_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_curriculum, list_posts, read_post · Public sink: search, list_posts, read_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
